method: Read-only review of the final uniqueness-005 source, prior reviewed complete-purity source and final concrete witness; exact current source/snapshot hashes and existing public/witness log parsing. No Lean, runtime or old scientific gate rerun.

extension_checks.finding: J:Matrix beta alpha C requires only J†J=I_alpha. Actual single Kraus K=I_iota⊗J has K†K=I_(iota×alpha), hence the existing RectangularChannel supplies genuine CPTP amplification/state typing. No coisometry assumption is smuggled in.

For every system index i,j, the output auxiliary block is J X^(ij) J† for arbitrary complex X. Actual discardRight sums its diagonal, so trace cycling and J†J=I give trace(X^(ij)). This is a complex operator equality on all X, not merely equality of real traces or diagonal densities.

Use the full IsPure converse to obtain a normalized vector; outer_mulVec identifies the actual channel output with the embedded vector outer product. The existing CPTP output Density provides trace one, and isPure_iff_exists_vector returns extremality in the entire enlarged density space. No selected-state purity is substituted.

auxiliaryInl=[I_alpha;0] and auxiliaryInr=[0;I_beta] each have a separately proved source-typed J†J=I. Both actual extensions land in Density(iota×(alpha⊕beta)) and separately preserve complete purity and the original system marginal. Only there is the same-carrier unitary theorem applied.

The final theorem quantifies arbitrary finite alpha,beta without a relative dimension assumption. Its square two-sided U acts on alpha⊕beta. It does not claim minimal padding, a direct isometry in an unspecified dimension direction, or a rectangular unitary. Empty-state premises remain impossible where appropriate; generic isometries and zero-dimensional identities remain well typed.

concrete_witness_checks: Actual rational complex U has both unitary identities and sends firstVector to secondVector through I⊗U. Actual Gram and discardRight equalities prove the common marginal, while joint vectors and densities are separately proved different.

Three wrong-direction controls compare outer-product density entries, hence a global phase cannot hide an error. Correct (00,01)=108/625 differs from U†=108i/625 and Uᵀ=−108i/625; correct (00,10)=−144i/625 differs from conjugate U=144i/625.

The two-to-three auxiliary enlargement is the actual left inclusion Fin2→Fin2⊕Unit. J†J=I and JJ†≠I are both proved, with the latter witnessed at the added coordinate. Complete purity/marginal preservation and a further common five-dimensional unitary are actual theorem instances.
